channel.title: Global Dispatch News
channel.description: Global economy, climate change, trade, and diplomacy

item.title: Global Climate Summit Concludes With Historic Clean Energy Accord
item.description: Delegates from 140 countries reach a landmark agreement to triple renewable energy investments and phase out coal subsidies by 2030.

item.title: Central Banks Signal Interest Rate Cuts as Global Inflation Cools Rapidly
item.description: Economic indicators show steady price stability, leading central banks to forecast interest rate reductions to stimulate sustainable economic growth.

item.title: Autonomous Cargo Fleets Begin Maritime Pacific Green Shipping Routes
item.description: Zero-emission autonomous container vessels complete their maiden trans-Pacific voyage, slashing maritime freight costs and emissions.

item.title: Global Semiconductor Alliance Expands Fabrication Hubs Across Three Continents
item.description: International supply chain partners inaugurate three gigafabs dedicated to high-precision 1nm chips for AI computation.
